reading.body:
This Meta facility in Utah County sits in a state where 21 mapped data center campuses exist but only 9 have published power figures. The facility's own specifications do not include a megawatt capacity, so its actual size cannot be compared to the 52.18 MW of published capacity across Utah's facilities. It ranks tenth among published figures in the state, a ranking that reflects only those campuses that disclosed power consumption on their spec pages, not all facilities present.

The research record shows no location-specific opening date, investment amount, or building detail is available in public sources consulted. The facility exists in the registry and is attributed to Meta as both operator and owner, but Wikipedia sources for both the Meta company and the specific county did not confirm facility-level facts during this search. The research budget for this location is exhausted.

Without published power capacity, megawatt-to-rack conversion is not possible for this campus. The operator's AI infrastructure commitments are documented at company scale rather than at this site, so this facility's role in Meta's data center fleet cannot be sized from the data provided. Whether this campus is material to AI scaling depends on the unpublished megawatt figures it does not disclose.
